title: Repository inventory scan
purpose: Produce deterministic repository inventory without whole-repository LLM context.
entry_condition: doctorcode scan is invoked for an accessible path.

transitions.action: Normalize root and walk non-ignored entries.
Sort language names and emit text or JSON.

invariants: The scanner must not claim semantic analysis from extension-based language recognition.
failure_behavior: Filesystem walk errors fail closed instead of claiming complete coverage.
restart_behavior: A scan is stateless and may be rerun from the repository root.
rollback_behavior: No persistent repository mutation occurs during scan.
